summary: Public RNA-seq exists for planarian (GSE98084, GSE103633) and Xenopus (GSE88975) regeneration, and GEO holds plant and biofilm series, but nothing harmonises regeneration-vs-wound designs across kingdoms; the biofilm and plant regeneration series were located only as counts, not examined, and no drug-response data for biofilms or Physarum were found.
